name: trades
description: Eligible source trade records. Identity is (provider_id, symbol, source_generation, time_msc, occurrence); equal rows remain distinct.

context.source_generation: Changes whenever source prefix/order is corrected or publisher restarts.
context.exchange_timezone: IANA timezone used to interpret session boundaries.
context.volume_unit: Stable unit for volume in this delivery.

fields.name: time_msc
fields.doc: UTC source event timestamp in milliseconds.

fields.name: volume_real
fields.doc: Optional provider real volume; null when unavailable.

fields.name: raw_flags
fields.doc: Unmodified provider update and aggressor flags.

fields.name: occurrence
fields.doc: Zero-based source position among eligible trades at this millisecond.
